en: Black‑and‑white postcard view across a river toward a riverside bathing complex and surrounding city buildings. A long, low riverside structure with crowds and parasols stands behind a fence, with apartment blocks and a church steeple in the background and an electricity pylon in the center. In the foreground is the riverbank and a wooden fence. Caption text is printed in white along the bottom edge, and a small credit with date appears at the lower right.
